← Back to campus

A campus built from observation.

470 photo galleries, street-level views, architecture sources and elevation references used to guide the recreation. Photographs remain at their original sources; they are visual references, not copied game textures. Modelled façades and many dimensions remain approximations.

WALLACE HIGH STREET RETURN

Wallace Wurth · High Street folded return and pale older end

Official Street View at 9 High Street, -33.9165748, 151.2364479, inspected natively and rotated for a closer view. Visible capture date October 2020. Resolves orientation: the new wing’s folded treatment wraps onto High Street, while the older wing’s northern end is pale. The brick end in the completed south-east gallery photos is southern. The reconstructed north return uses five estimated bays; exact panel counts, colours and present condition remain uncertain.
